title: CHAPTER 2: UNDERSTANDING FOREIGN POLICY AND DIPLOMACY
content: ✨እንኳን ወደ ኢትዮጵያ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ታሪክና ዝግመተ-ለውጥ ሂደቱ ትምህርት በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል ከ19ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን አጋማሽ (አጼ ቴዎድሮስ) ጀምሮ እስከ ድህረ-1991 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ የነበሩት አራቱ የተለያዩ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስታት የተከተሏቸውን የውጭ ፖሊሲ ግቦች፣ ስልቶች፣ ተፎካካሪ ኃይሎችና የተገኙ ስኬቶችን በዝርዝር እናያለን👇👇። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.3.1. Foreign Policy during Emperor Tewodros II (1855–1868) 🔹 Context & Primary Goal: - Modern imperial state began to emerge in the middle of the 19th century after Zemene Mesafint (Era of Princes). - Tewodros II was predominantly concerned with internal consolidation, re-unifying fragmented empire parts, and introducing modernity and a modern army. - 👉 አጼ ቴዎድሮስ በዘመነ መሳፍንት የተበታተነችውን ኢትዮጵያ አንድ ማድረግ፣ ማዕከላዊ መንግስት መመስረትና ሀገሪቱን ማዘመን ዋነኛ ዓላማቸው ነበር። 🔹 Foreign Policy Strategy: - Reached out beyond the Horn of Africa to Western Christian powers (Britain, France, Russia). - Appealed to shared Christian heritage to gain military/technical aid to fight against regional expansionist threats: Turks (Ottoman Empire), Egyptians, and neighboring Islamic powers. - 👉 የውጭ ፖሊሲያቸው በክርስትና ሃይማኖት አንድነት ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ ከአውሮፓ ክርስቲያን ሀገራት የቴክኖሎጂና ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ለማግኘት አልመው ነበር። 🔹 Challenges & Outcome: - Britain sent religious missionaries instead of requested engineers, artisans, and modern military technology. - Queen Victoria ignored Tewodros's letter demanding equal diplomatic status. - Out of frustration, Tewodros took British consul and missionaries hostage. - Led to the 1868 Napier British Military Expedition -> Tewodros was defeated at Magdala and tragically committed suicide rather than surrender. - 👉 የእንግሊዝ መንግስት የቴዎድሮስን ደብዳቤ ችላ በማለቱና ቴክኖሎጂ ሳይሆን ሃይማኖታዊ ሚሲዮናውያንን በመላኩ፣ ንጉሱ ታጋቾችን ወሰዱ፤ ይህም በእንግሊዝ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻና በንጉሱ መስዋዕትነት አበቃ። 💡 Exam Hint: አጼ ቴዎድሮስ የክርስቲያን አውሮፓ ሀገራትን ወታደራዊና ቴክኖሎጂያዊ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ክርስትናን እንደ የውጭ ፖሊሲ መሳሪያ (Instrument of foreign policy) ተጠቅመዋል! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.3.2. Foreign Policy during Emperor Yohannes IV (1872–1889) 🔹 Threat Assessment: - Identified two existential external threats to Ethiopia's sovereignty: 1. Muslim Threat (Egypt): Egypt attempted multiple invasions under various pretexts, but its real motive was controlling the source of the Blue Nile. 2. European Colonial Expansionism (Italy): Posed a severe long-term threat as Italy grabbed the Massawa port in 1885. - 👉 አጼ ዮሐንስ የሀገሪቱን ህልውና የሚፈታተኑ ሁለት ዋና ዋና ስጋቶችን ለይተዋል፦ የግብፅ ወረራ (ዓላማዋ አባይን መቆጣጠር ነበር) እና የአውሮፓ ሊቀ-ቅኝ አገዛዝ (በተለይ ጣሊያን በ1885 ምፅዋን ከተቆጣጠረች በኋላ)። 🔹 Military & Diplomatic Responses: - Defeated Egyptian forces decisively at the Battle of Gundet (1875) and Battle of Gura (1876). - Italian Foreign Minister explicitly declared: "The Red Sea is the key to the Mediterranean", signaling Italy's strategic desire to colonize Ethiopia. - Yohannes IV died in 1889 fighting the Sudanese Mahdist forces at Matamma/Gallabat. (Mahdists invaded because they wrongly assumed Yohannes was collaborating with Britain). - 👉 ግብፅ በጉንደትና በጉራ ጦርነቶች ተሸንፋለች። አጼ ዮሐንስ የሱዳን መሃዲስት ኃይሎችን ሲዋጉ በመተማ ጦርነት መስዋዕት ሆኑ። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.3.3. Foreign Policy during Emperor Menelik II (1889–1913) 🔹 Pre-Coronation Strategy (King of Shewa/Shoa): - Expanded sphere of influence towards South and East to gain access to trade routes and the sea port of Zeila. - Maintained temporary friendly diplomatic relations with Italy to obtain firearms and balance against Yohannes IV. 🔹 Post-Coronation Challenges: - Heightened Scramble for Africa surrounding Ethiopia on all four corners. - Italian expansion into the hinterland crossing the Tekeze River (establishing Eritrea). 🔹 Double-Track Diplomacy: 1. Peaceful Engagement / Treaties: Signed the Wuchale Treaty (1889) for friendship and peace. 2. Military Preparedness: Actively accumulated firearms and ammunitions from European suppliers to defend national sovereignty. - 👉 Double-track diplomacy፦ በአንድ በኩል በውይይትና ውል በመፈራረም (የዉጫሌ ውል)፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ዘመናዊ መሣሪያዎችን በማከማቸት ለጦርነት መዘጋጀት። የኛ ንጉሥ ሚኒልክ ቀና የማለታችን ምክንያት ስምህ ለዘለዓለም ይንገስ💪። 🔹 The Wuchale Treaty Controversy & Battle of Adwa: - Article 17 Controversy: Amharic version stated Ethiopia could optionally use Italian good offices for foreign relations; Italian version made it mandatory, reducing Ethiopia to an Italian protectorate. - Menelik abrogated the treaty in 1893. Italy launched military aggression from the north. - Battle of Adwa (1896): Ethiopian forces completely defeated the Italian colonial army. 🔹 Global Significance of Adwa: - Major European powers recognized Ethiopia as an independent sovereign African state. - Britain, France, Russia, and Italy sent formal diplomatic ambassadors to Menelik's Palace in Addis Ababa. - Signed formal international boundary treaties (defining modern borders on paper with Djibouti, Kenya, Somaliland, and Eritrea, though demarcation gaps caused future disputes with Somalia and Sudan). - 👉 የዓድዋ ድል አውሮፓውያን የኢትዮጵያን ነፃነትና እኩልነት እንዲቀበሉና የድንበር ውሎችን እንዲፈራረሙ አድርጓል። 💡 Exam Hint: የዉጫሌ ውል አንቀጽ 17 (Article 17) አሻሚነት እና የአድዋ ድል የድንበር ውሎች መፈረም ለፈተና በጣም አስፈላጊ ነጥቦች ናቸው! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.3.4. Foreign Policy during Emperor Haile Selassie I (1916–1974) 🔹 Core Objectives: - Modernization, centralization, international recognition, and protecting territorial integrity. 🔹 Key Diplomatic Milestones & Strategic Shift: - League of Nations (1923): Joined the League to secure collective security against potential Italian invasion. - Fascist Italian Invasion (1936–1941): Collective security system failed; League ignored Haile Selassie's plea in Geneva. Emperor went into exile in London. - British Patronage & Liberation: Leveraged British strategic needs to liberate Ethiopia in 1941. - Shift to US Patronage: Fearing British protectorate ambitions, Ethiopia shifted alliance to the USA. 🔹 Ethio-US Strategic Alliance (1953 Mutual Defense Assistance Agreement): - USA established Kagnew Communication Station in Asmara. - USA provided ~$280 million military aid and trained ~3,978 Ethiopian soldiers (1953–1976). - Aid helped emperor suppress internal peasant rebellions, quell Eritrean nationalism, and deter Somali irredentist threats. - 👉 ኢትዮጵያ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ጠንካራ ወታደራዊ ህብረት በመፍጠር የካግኒው ጣቢያን (Kagnew Station) የሰጠች ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካ ደግሞ ዘመናዊ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ሰጥታለች። 🔹 Pan-African & International Leadership: - Founding father of the Organization of African Unity (OAU) in 1963; established headquarters in Addis Ababa. - Championed African independence, anti-colonialism, and anti-apartheid struggles. - Contributed peacekeeping troops to Korea (1951) and Congo (1961) under UN umbrella. - Mediated the 1972 Sudan conflict (Addis Ababa Agreement). ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.3.5. Foreign Policy during the Military Government / Dergue (1974–1991) 🔹 Ideological Departure: - Adopted Socialism / Marxism-Leninism. Foreign policy shifted to alignment with the Eastern Bloc (USSR, Cuba, East Germany). - Core objectives: Regime survival, territorial integrity, and socialist restructuring. 🔹 Rupture with the West & Superpower Rivalry: - US criticized Dergue's human rights violations. Dergue closed the US military base and Kagnew station within 72 hours. - Somali Invasion of Ogaden (1977–1978): USSR made a dramatic shift from Somalia to Ethiopia, pouring in massive military hardware, advisors, and Cuban troops to defeat Somali aggression. - East Germany (GDR): Assisted in setting up and training the security services and cadres. 🔹 Regional Dynamics & Middle East Policy: - Eritrean Conflict & External Backers: ELF/EPLF supported by Arab regimes (Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Sudan) and later the USA. - Sudan Relations: Highly strained. Sudan harbored Ethiopian rebel groups; Ethiopia supported SPLA (Sudan People's Liberation Army) in South Sudan. - Supported Palestinian cause and severed ties with Israel, yet Arab perception remained largely hostile. 🔹 Collapse & Lessons: - Cold War ended -> USSR stopped aid -> Dergue regime collapsed in 1991. - Continuity Concept: Though ideology changed drastically, the primary objective (territorial integrity, Nile security, regional power) remained unchanged, proving geography is a primary determinant of Ethiopian foreign policy. - 👉 የደርግ አገዛዝ ወደ ሶሻሊዝም ቢያደላም፣ የሀገር ህልውናና የድንበር ደህንነትን የማስጠበቅ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ግቡ ከቀደሙት ነገስታት ጋር ተመሳሳይ ነበር። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.3.6. Foreign Policy of Ethiopia in Post-1991 (EPRDF Era) 🔹 New Paradigm: Democracy & Development - Foreign policy driven by ensuring national interest and multi-national state survival through Democratization and Rapid Economic Development (combating poverty, disease, ignorance). - Identifies domestic problems (lack of good governance, poverty, internal conflict) as primary threats to national survival and image. 🔹 The "Inside-Out" Approach: - Priority is solving internal domestic problems first (building national consensus, democracy, economic growth) to eliminate external vulnerabilities. - External threats can only be deterred if the country builds internal economic capacity and democratic cohesion. - 👉 "Inside-Out" Approach፦ የውጭ ስጋትን ለመቀነስ እና ነፃነትን ለማስከበር አስቀድሞ የሀገር ውስጥ ችግሮችን (ድህነት፣ የመልካም አስተዳደር እጦት) መፍታት ይገባል የሚል መርህ ነው። 🔹 Pillars of Modern Strategy: 1. Economic Diplomacy: Attracting Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), securing export markets, concessional loans, and exploiting globalization opportunities (free trade, tech transfer). 2. Look-East Policy: Learning economic success models from East Asian nations (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia). 3. Military Deterrence & Dialogue: Prioritizing peaceful dialogue and negotiation while building modern military capabilities to deter foreign aggression. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 CHAPTER SUMMARY: CHANGES AND CONTINUITIES | Regime / Period | Core Strategy | Primary International Patron | Key Achievement / Focus | |---|---|---|---| | Tewodros II | Religious Appeal & Modernization | Reached out to Britain/France | Modern army idea & Unification | | Yohannes IV | Defense against Egypt & Italy | None (Fought external enemies) | Gundet & Gura Victories | | Menelik II | Double-Track Diplomacy | France, Russia, Italy (early) | Victory of Adwa & Defined Borders | | Haile Selassie I | Collective Security & Patronage | League of Nations, UK, then USA | OAU Founding & UN Peacekeeping | | Military (Dergue) | Socialist Alignment & Military Force | USSR, Cuba, East Germany | Defeated Somali aggression | | Post-1991 | "Inside-Out" & Economic Diplomacy | Multi-vector (East & West) | Poverty reduction & Economic growth | 👉 Core Continuity: Across all four regimes, the primary foreign policy goal remained constant: Maintaining territorial integrity, sovereignty, and independence of Ethiopia! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 👋 የዚህን ምዕራፍ ሙሉ ይዘት መስፈርት በጠበቀ መልኩ አጠናቀናል። እነዚህን ዝርዝር ኖቶች፣ ምሳሌዎች እና የፈተና ጥቆማዎች (Exam Hints) በጥንቃቄ በማንበብ ለፈተናችሁ ከፍተኛ ውጤት ተዘጋጁ የሁልጊዜ ቤተሠባዊ ምክራችን ነው። መልካም የጥናት ጊዜ ይሁንላችሁ! 🙏🙏🙏
